title: La Voz: huecos más anchos
description: docs/quests/marta.md § The fight (2026-11-27). La Voz's gaps reach into her notes: 0.3 s on each side of a silence and, even where she sings on, 0.15 s on each side of every change of note; she has 660 PV. Fight tester: Gerard in Matemágico, Aitor in Papagato, free maná, no PV lost. Run it with --gpu.

steps.eval: navigator.getGamepads = () => []; window.ui = window.gerard.battleUI; window.ready = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.phase === 'player' && !ui.fight.busy && !document.querySelector('#battle[data-entering]') && document.activeElement?.matches('.command-trigger'); window.song = () => ui.fight && ui.fight.song; window.cmd = id => document.querySelector('[data-command="' + id + '"] .command-trigger').click(); window.sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); window.round = async (id, what = 'attack') => { for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) { while (!ready()) await sleep(100); cmd(what); await sleep(450); document.querySelector('.battle-target[data-target="' + id + '"]')?.click(); await sleep(500); } }; const st = document.createElement('style'); st.textContent = '.shot-frozen * { animation-play-state: paused !important; }'; document.head.append(st); window.frozen = ''; window.catchNote = (test, after = 120) => { window.frozen = ''; const o = new MutationObserver(() => { const hit = [...document.querySelectorAll('.damage-pop small, .damage-pop strong')].find(el => test(el.textContent)); if (hit) { o.disconnect(); setTimeout(() => { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 0; document.documentElement.classList.add('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = hit.textContent; }, after); } }); o.observe(document.body, { childList: true, subtree: true }); }; window.thaw = () => { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 1; document.documentElement.classList.remove('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = ''; };

window.ring = () => document.querySelector('.status-icon[data-status="cancion"]'); window.prev = undefined; window.boundGap = () => { const now = song(), r = ring(); if (!now || !r) return false; const open = now.startsWith('Nota') && !r.hasAttribute('data-sounding'); if (now !== window.prev) { window.changedFrom = window.prev; window.prev = now; window.changedAt = performance.now(); } return open && window.changedFrom && window.changedFrom.startsWith('Nota') && performance.now() - window.changedAt < 140; }; 0

window.frozen = ''; (function look() { if (window.boundGap()) { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 0; document.documentElement.classList.add('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = 'ligado'; return; } requestAnimationFrame(look); })(); 0

steps.caption: Even where she sings on, each change of note opens a short gap: the plate still names the note, but the ring is grey at its break and she is solid, there to be struck

steps.eval: cmd('attack'); window.aimed = false; setTimeout(() => (function look() { if (window.boundGap()) { const voz = () => ui.live.foes.find(f => f.kind === 'voz'), hp = voz().hp; document.querySelector('.battle-target[data-target="voz"]')?.click(); window.aimed = true; (function hurt() { if (voz().hp < hp) { setTimeout(() => { window.gerard.game.app.timeScale = 0; document.documentElement.classList.add('shot-frozen'); window.frozen = 'golpe'; }, 160); return; } requestAnimationFrame(hurt); })(); return; } requestAnimationFrame(look); })(), 450); 0

steps.caption: A blow pressed in that gap between two bound notes finds her: it lands instead of going through her
